notes.amidah_avot: The tight Avot crop confirms defective וְקֹנֵה, with no vav after qof, and a visible dot in the dalet of חַסְדֵּי. The two independent readings differ; the image settles each occurrence.
notes.amidah_teshuvah: The tight source crop (450,1930,700,2010), enlarged fourfold, confirms two sets of abbreviation marks and a patah under aleph. The earlier adjudication is superseded; the abbr/expan structure is retained.
notes.amidah_geullah: The seal’s gimel has its visible dot in the tight crop; retain the primary/first-independent reading גּוֹאֵל.
notes.amidah_tzaddiqim: The bet of בָּטָחְנוּ has a clear interior dot in the tight s11 crop.
notes.amidah_yerushalayim: The source prints Jerusalem defectively, without yod, in both occurrences; the enlarged independent reading preserves that spelling and pointing.
notes.amidah_hodaah: The source joins כליום without a separator. Preserve that printed form and supply the missing maqaf only through a separate sic/corr record.
notes.amidah_elohai_netzor: The tight crop confirms defective וְגֹאֲלִי; the second enlarged reader’s added vav is rejected. The printed מחשבתם and punctuation follow the first independent reading.
notes.amidah_yehi_ratzon: Reinspection agrees with the secondary reader: the prefixed Name has patah under lamed and qamatz under the yods, but no sheva. Neighboring sheva dots in מנחת are visible in the same crop. This supersedes the earlier sheva adjudication.
notes.amidah_qedushah: The source has a full stop after יֹאמֵרוּ; the later reader’s colon is rejected. Speaker abbreviations are separate description notes, resolved by the user as חזן and קהל.
notes.amidah_minim: The secondary reader and enlarged s10 seal confirm defective שֹׁבֵר, without vav. This corrects the transcription, not the printed source.
notes.amidah_modim_derabbanan: The secondary audit identified defective spellings. Native-source s12 crop (80,100,750,400) confirms no vav in לשמר, לחצרת and רצנך; these correct transcription errors, not source errors.

user_role_confirmation: The user identified the Rashi-script speaker abbreviations as ק׳=קהל and ח׳=חזן. Retain abbr/expan choices in description notes, outside prayer words.
